name: PixRem – Unused Image Cleaner
author: Ognjen

sections.description:
PixRem scans your WordPress site to find images no longer in use and helps you safely delete them to save storage space and improve performance.

Key benefits:
– 🕵️‍♂️ Comprehensive detection: scans posts, pages, custom post types, serialized data, ACF, Elementor, Divi, Bricks, WPBakery
– 🛒 WooCommerce support: finds featured & gallery images
– ⚙️ Theme options & SEO: custom logos, backgrounds, Yoast OG images, site icon
– 🛡 Automatic backup: every deleted image is saved to /wp-content/uploads/pixrem-backups/YYYY/MM/
– 📝 Log system: review all deletions and restore individual images
– 🔒 Whitelist / Exclude: prevent deletion of critical files by ID or path
sections.installation:
1. Upload the pixrem folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin via the Plugins menu
  3. Go to PixRem in the admin sidebar
  4. Click Start Scan and review unused images
sections.faq:
Is it safe to delete images?

Yes. Deleted files are backed up automatically, so you can restore them if needed.

How do I restore a deleted image?

Use the Restore from Backup link shown after deletion, or copy the file manually from /wp-content/uploads/pixrem-backups/YYYY/MM/.

How does the whitelist work?

Enter attachment IDs (comma-separated) or upload paths/folders (one per line) in PixRem → Whitelist to always skip those files.
